purpose: Navigation from a claim to existing inputs, commands, saved results and interpretation limits.

decisions.question: Does lower full-arm error establish helpful response to the changed history?
decisions.contract: 1,024 keyed center histories [N,12] -> center forecasts [N,12]; 256 common contexts.
decisions.decision: Retain the lower full-arm error of mixed STID, but do not infer helpful changed-history response from that diagonal score.
decisions.limits: Accuracy and response are separate properties. The paper averages three seed losses; this command scores one seed. Contexts are dependent and development-exposed.

decisions.question: Which conclusions survive the declared target alternatives for fixed forecasts?
read_together: all seed outcomes and loss means
decisions.decision: Mixed STID mean response is adverse throughout the declared segment, while its diagonal advantage changes sign. Keep the slightly positive residual-endpoint result for seed 3.
decisions.limits: The segment interpolates two frozen clipped targets; it is neither a calibrated generator family nor a physical uncertainty interval. The tested hidden internal reversal hypothesis is unsupported.

decisions.question: Does helpful total response extend to the other-sequence inputs under an event center?
decisions.contract: 68,544 keyed complete histories [N,12,9] -> center forecasts [N,12]; 11,424 scenarios.
decisions.decision: Retain helpful total response and report the small harmful conditional other-sequence response. Examine both training variants and target laws, including helpful profile groups.
decisions.limits: The mixed legacy conditional error increase is approximately 0.50%. Profile similarity is not measured adjacency; this is a functional input comparison on conditional numeric constructions.
decisions.neural_use_decision: All six primary neural configurations have helpful total response but harmful other-input response on spanning cases under both laws; retain original accuracy and all timing/profile outcomes.

decisions.reader: Prediction researcher or joint-input model user
decisions.question: Does the pooled response describe each event timing?
read_together: A for every timing, configuration and target law
decisions.decision: All six STID checkpoints have adverse pooled but helpful spanning response under both laws. Keep both judgments and the zero response for future-starting groups.
decisions.limits: Four timings have equal construction weight. These weights do not estimate real incident frequencies. Replay is reproduction of frozen results, not an independent experiment.
decisions.neural_use_decision: All six primary GWN checkpoints have adverse pooled but helpful spanning response under both laws. Equal-history forecast differences are at most 0.000244140625, within the declared 0.001 tolerance; they are not bitwise zero.

decisions.reader: Resource curator or forecasting benchmark user
decisions.question: Does record uniqueness imply unseen traffic at the prediction input unit?
decisions.decision: Report the original mixed-split gain of only 0.12%, entirely on controls, and its zero full-nine-slot hits separately from the external 11.79% gain on 93/839 traffic history/future hits.
decisions.limits: The external pinned source is not bundled. Saved outcomes and source certificates are inspectable locally; rerunning the source audit requires that file. Numerical equality does not identify physical source records or neural shortcut use.

decisions.question: Which input reuse and training support remain after exclusion?
decisions.decision: Network target-support exclusion leaves a 4.97% local lookup gain. Flow-history exclusion empties 51 of 496 station views; including calendar history changes both support and residual matches.
decisions.limits: TargetSupport masks use query targets offline. No exclusion repairs chronology or proves statistical adequacy. Keep every query and station, including empty views. External audit replay requires the pinned source.

neural_use_extension_scientific_study: One architecture; six primary fits, one superseded completed technical fit and one interrupted attempt; zero new scenarios or observations.
scientific_experiments_added_scope: This navigation document; the separate supplied neural study has one architecture and six primary fits.
